1.english_reference: And it came to pass , that after the year was expired ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֡י לְ עֵת֩ תְּשׁוּבַ֨ת הַ שָּׁנָ֜ה
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἐπιόντι ἔτει
traditions.VUL: Factum est autem post anni círculum ,
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass , that after the year was expired ,

1.english_reference: at the time that kings go out [ to battle ] ,

traditions.WLC: לְ עֵ֣ת צֵ֣את הַ מְּלָכִ֗ים
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῇ ἐξόδῳ τῶν βασιλέων
traditions.VUL: eo témpore , quo solent reges ad bella procédere ,
traditions.KJV: at the time that kings go out [ to battle ] ,

1.english_reference: Joab led forth the power of the army ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּנְהַ֣ג יוֹאָב֩ אֶת חֵ֨יל הַ צָּבָ֜א
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤγαγεν Ἰωὰβ πᾶσαν τὴν δύναμιν τῆς στρατείας ,
traditions.VUL: congregávit Ioab exércitum , et robur milítiæ ,
traditions.KJV: Joab led forth the power of the army ,

1.english_reference: and wasted the country of the children of Ammon ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּשְׁחֵ֣ת אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ בְּנֵֽי עַמּ֗וֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔφθειραν τὴν χώραν υἱῶν Ἀμμών ·
traditions.VUL: et vastávit terram filiórum Ammon :
traditions.KJV: and wasted the country of the children of Ammon ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹא֙ וַ יָּ֣צַר אֶת רַבָּ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθεν καὶ περιεκάθισεν τὴν Ῥάββαν .
traditions.VUL: perrexítque et obsédit Rabba :
traditions.KJV: and came and besieged Rabbah .

traditions.WLC: וְ דָוִ֖יד יֹשֵׁ֣ב בִּ ירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ Δαυεὶδ ἐκάθητο ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ·
traditions.VUL: porro David manébat in Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: But David tarried at Jerusalem .

1.english_reference: And Joab smote Rabbah , and destroyed it .

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֥ךְ יוֹאָ֛ב אֶת רַבָּ֖ה וַ יֶּֽהֶרְסֶֽ הָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὴν Ῥαββὰ καὶ κατέσκαψεν αὐτήν .
traditions.VUL: quando Ioab percússit Rabba et destrúxit eam .
traditions.KJV: And Joab smote Rabbah , and destroyed it .

2.english_reference: And David took the crown of their king from off his head ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקַּ֣ח דָּוִ֣יד אֶת עֲטֶֽרֶת מַלְכָּ ם֩ מֵ עַ֨ל רֹאשׁ֜ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔλαβεν Δαυεὶδ τὸν στέφανον Μολχὸλ βασιλέως αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Tulit autem David corónam Melchom de cápite eius ,
traditions.KJV: And David took the crown of their king from off his head ,

2.english_reference: and found it to weigh a talent of gold ,

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּמְצָאָ֣ הּ מִשְׁקַ֣ל כִּכַּר זָהָ֗ב
traditions.LXX: καὶ εὑρέθη ὁ σταθμὸς αὐτοῦ τάλαντον χρυσίου ,
traditions.VUL: et invénit in ea auri pondo taléntum ,
traditions.KJV: and found it to weigh a talent of gold ,

2.english_reference: and [ there were ] precious stones in it ;

traditions.WLC: וּ בָ הּ֙ אֶ֣בֶן יְקָרָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν αὐτῷ λίθος τίμιος ,
traditions.VUL: et pretiosíssimas gemmas ,
traditions.KJV: and [ there were ] precious stones in it ;

2.english_reference: and it was set upon David ’s head :

traditions.WLC: וַ תְּהִ֖י עַל רֹ֣אשׁ דָּוִ֑יד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν Δαυείδ ·
traditions.VUL: fecítque sibi inde diadéma :
traditions.KJV: and it was set upon David ’s head :

2.english_reference: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city .

traditions.WLC: וּ שְׁלַ֥ל הָ עִ֛יר הוֹצִ֖יא הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד
traditions.LXX: καὶ σκῦλα τῆς πόλεως ἐξήνεγκεν πολλὰ σφόδρα .
traditions.VUL: manúbias quoque urbis plúrimas tulit :
traditions.KJV: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city .

3.english_reference: And he brought out the people that [ were ] in it ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת הָ עָ֨ם אֲשֶׁר בָּ֜ הּ הוֹצִ֗יא
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸν λαὸν τὸν ἐν αὐτῇ ἐξήγαγεν
traditions.VUL: pópulum autem , qui erat in ea , edúxit ,
traditions.KJV: And he brought out the people that [ were ] in it ,

3.english_reference: and cut [ them ] with saws , and with harrows of iron , and with axes .

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֨שַׂר בַּ מְּגֵרָ֜ה וּ בַ חֲרִיצֵ֤י הַ בַּרְזֶל֙ וּ בַ מְּגֵר֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ διέπρισεν πρίοσιν καὶ ἐν σκεπάρνοις σιδηροῖς ,
traditions.VUL: et fecit super eos tríbulas , et trahas , et ferráta carpénta transíre , ita ut dissecaréntur et contereréntur :
traditions.KJV: and cut [ them ] with saws , and with harrows of iron , and with axes .

3.english_reference: Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon .

traditions.WLC: וְ כֵן֙ יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה דָוִ֔יד לְ כֹ֖ל עָרֵ֣י בְנֵי עַמּ֑וֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὕτως ἐποίησεν Δαυεὶδ τοῖς παισὶν υἱοῖς Ἀμμών ·
traditions.VUL: sic fecit David cunctis úrbibus filiórum Ammon :
traditions.KJV: Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon .

3.english_reference: And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem .

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֧שָׁב דָּוִ֛יד וְ כָל הָ עָ֖ם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέστρεψεν Δαυεὶδ καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς αὐτοῦ εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ .
traditions.VUL: et revérsus est cum omni pópulo suo in Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem .

4.english_reference: And it came to pass after this , that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִי֙ אַחֲרֵי כֵ֔ן וַ תַּעֲמֹ֧ד מִלְחָמָ֛ה בְּ גֶ֖זֶר עִם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ ταῦτα καὶ ἐγένετο ἔτι πόλεμος ἐν Γάζερ μετὰ τῶν ἀλλοφύλων ·
traditions.VUL: Post hæc ínitum est bellum in Gazer advérsum Philisthǽos ,
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass after this , that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines ;

4.english_reference: at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai , [ that was ] of the children of the giant :

traditions.WLC: אָ֣ז הִכָּ֞ה סִבְּכַ֣י הַ חֻֽשָׁתִ֗י אֶת סִפַּ֛י מִ ילִדֵ֥י הָ רְפָאִ֖ים
traditions.LXX: τότε ἐπάταξεν Σοβοχαὶ Θωσαθεὶ τὸν Σαφοὺτ ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν τῶν γιγάντων
traditions.VUL: in quo percússit Sobóchai Husathítes , Sáphai de génere Ráphaim ,
traditions.KJV: at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai , [ that was ] of the children of the giant :

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּכָּנֵֽעוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐταπείνωσεν αὐτόν .
traditions.VUL: et humiliávit eos .
traditions.KJV: and they were subdued .

5.english_reference: And there was war again with the Philistines ;

traditions.WLC: וַ תְּהִי ע֥וֹד מִלְחָמָ֖ה אֶת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο ἔτι πόλεμος μετὰ τῶν ἀλλοφύλων ,
traditions.VUL: Aliud quoque bellum gestum est advérsus Philisthǽos ,
traditions.KJV: And there was war again with the Philistines ;

5.english_reference: and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֞ךְ אֶלְחָנָ֣ן בֶּן יעור אֶת לַחְמִי֙ אֲחִי֙ גָּלְיָ֣ת הַ גִּתִּ֔י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπάταξεν Ἐλλὰν υἱὸς Ἰαεὶρ τὸν Ἐλεμεὲ ἀδελφὸν Γολιὰθ τοῦ Γεθθαίου ,
traditions.VUL: in quo percússit Adeódatus fílius Saltus Bethlehemítes fratrem Góliath Gethǽi ,
traditions.KJV: and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite ,

5.english_reference: whose spear staff [ was ] like a weaver ’s beam .

traditions.WLC: וְ עֵ֣ץ חֲנִית֔ וֹ כִּ מְנ֖וֹר אֹרְגִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ξύλον δόρατος αὐτοῦ ὡς ἀντίον ὑφαινόντων .
traditions.VUL: cuius hastæ lignum erat quasi liciatórium texéntium .
traditions.KJV: whose spear staff [ was ] like a weaver ’s beam .

6.english_reference: And yet again there was war at Gath ,

traditions.WLC: וַ תְּהִי ע֥וֹד מִלְחָמָ֖ה בְּ גַ֑ת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο ἔτι πόλεμος ἐν Γέθ ,
traditions.VUL: Sed et áliud bellum áccidit in Geth ,
traditions.KJV: And yet again there was war at Gath ,

6.english_reference: where was a man of [ great ] stature ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֣י אִ֣ישׁ מִדָּ֗ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦν ἀνὴρ ὑπερμεγέθης ,
traditions.VUL: in quo fuit homo longíssimus ,
traditions.KJV: where was a man of [ great ] stature ,

6.english_reference: whose fingers and toes [ were ] four and twenty , six [ on each hand ] , and six [ on each foot ] :

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶצְבְּעֹתָ֤י ו שֵׁשׁ וָ שֵׁשׁ֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְ אַרְבַּ֔ע
traditions.LXX: καὶ δάκτυλοι αὐτοῦ ἓξ καὶ ἓξ , εἴκοσι τέσσαρες ·
traditions.VUL: senos habens dígitos , id est , simul vigínti quátuor :
traditions.KJV: whose fingers and toes [ were ] four and twenty , six [ on each hand ] ,

6.english_reference: and he also was the son of the giant .

traditions.WLC: וְ גַם ה֖וּא נוֹלַ֥ד לְ הָ רָפָֽא
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὗτος ἦν ἀπόγονος γιγάντων .
traditions.VUL: qui et ipse de Rapha fúerat stirpe generátus .
traditions.KJV: and six [ on each foot ] : and he also was the son of the giant .

traditions.WLC: וַ יְחָרֵ֖ף אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὠνείδισεν τὸν Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Hic blasphemávit Israel :
traditions.KJV: But when he defied Israel ,

7.english_reference: Jonathan the son of Shimea David ’s brother slew him .

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּכֵּ֨ הוּ֙ יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן בֶּן שִׁמְעָ֖א אֲחִ֥י דָוִֽיד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὸν Ἰωναθὰν υἱὸς Σαμαά , υἱὸς ἀδελφοῦ Δαυείδ .
traditions.VUL: et percússit eum Iónathan fílius Sámaa fratris David . Hi sunt fílii Rapha in Geth , qui cecidérunt in manu David et servórum eius .
traditions.KJV: Jonathan the son of Shimea David ’s brother slew him .

8.english_reference: These were born unto the giant in Gath ;

traditions.WLC: אֵ֛ל נוּלְּד֥וּ לְ הָ רָפָ֖א בְּ גַ֑ת
traditions.LXX: οὗτος ἐγένετο Ῥαφὰ ἐν Γέθ · πάντες ἦσαν τέσσαρες γίγαντες ,
traditions.VUL: Hic blasphemávit Israel : et percússit eum Iónathan fílius Sámaa fratris David . Hi sunt fílii Rapha in Geth ,
traditions.KJV: These were born unto the giant in Gath ;

8.english_reference: and they fell by the hand of David ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּפְּל֥וּ בְ יַד דָּוִ֖יד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔπεσον ἐν χειρὶ Δαυεὶδ
traditions.VUL: qui cecidérunt in manu David
traditions.KJV: and they fell by the hand of David ,

8.english_reference: and by the hand of his servants .

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ יַד עֲבָדָֽי ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν χειρὶ παίδων αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et servórum eius .
traditions.KJV: and by the hand of his servants .
